pick.headline: CIA officer Aldrich Ames arrested as a Russian spy
pick.summary: On 21 February 1994 the FBI arrested Aldrich Ames, a CIA counterintelligence officer, and his wife on charges of spying for Moscow since 1985.
pick.significance: Ames had betrayed many US agents in the Soviet Union, at least ten of whom were executed. It was the most damaging penetration in CIA history and strained US-Russian relations.

evidence.snippet: …r Russia LD2302090594 Moscow ITAR-TASS World Service in Russian 0751 GMT 23 Feb 94 [By ITAR-TASS correspondent Andrey Palariya] [Text] Moscow, 23 Feb— The U.S. Government has brought charges against CIA employee Aldrich Ames and his wife Maria Ames, accusing them of spying for the former Soviet Union and then Russia. The U.S. Justice Department said that Ames and his wife were arrested on Monday during a joint operation conducted by the CIA…
